meaning: One identity can be a finite procedure with enumerated variants. No variants are counted as executed cases. Null means an unresolved expectation, never a wildcard or pass. Full recipe, actual provider and diagnostic/outcome bindings require a later seal and grant.

defaults.filesystem: Controlled authority-limited VFS; no host paths, network or implicit dataWrite. Per-case grants only.
defaults.provider: Future independently qualified version-bound same-engine provider; none executed here.
defaults.limits: Author proposed NP1 caps are upper bounds for a later recipe, not an execution authorization. Missing context/scan/allocation charges must be bound before execution; no limit raise.
defaults.cleanup: Register before acquisition. Keep phase/admission/operation events, raw reason presence and identity, public pending state, iterator return, output retirement, outstanding jobs/host work and final closure. Never infer zero from unavailable telemetry.
defaults.negativeControls: Later implementation must bind and actually load scoped countercontrols; listed mutants here are plans, not mutation results.
defaults.shellRedirections: None; raw-handler and actual Shell boundaries must be reported separately.

holdouts.procedure: Freeze three grant vectors: sourceRead only, dataRead without jsonModules, jsonModules without dataRead, each with stdoutWrite/stderrWrite. Recommend all three deny this JSON request. Separately submit one request per exact malformed class: wrong-session resolveJson origin; own getter; inherited required field; extra key; missing key; array/hole instead of record; coercible object instead of string. Include one valid foreign-realm own-data record under fully granted authority.

holdouts.name: Serial output returns a boolean only after sink settlement
holdouts.procedure: Hold the first sink write after admission and before acknowledgement. Keep invocation pending and the second output operation unadmitted. Release then collect all output and cleanup.
holdouts.countercontrol: Return a Promise or true before acknowledgement, allowing the second write to start.
holdouts.qualification: This proves the declared serial NP1 profile, not stock Node Writable timing.

holdouts.unresolved: Ratify leading BOM stripping only in source/JSON-module loaders, not ordinary UTF8 data reads. This proposal follows D10 for JSON loading; no native run captured these bytes.
holdouts.countercontrol: Apply one BOM-stripping decoder indiscriminately to all data or fail a declared BOM-supported JSON require.

holdouts.procedure: After inventory approval bind this positive plus three isolated negatives: JSON.parse with a reviver that writes MARK; JSON.stringify with a callable replacer that writes MARK; fs.writeFileSync with a callback/unsupported own getter option. Unsupported variants must produce zero MARK bytes and zero underlying write calls; reject before invoking callbacks/getters. Do not globally ban ordinary JSON keys.

holdouts.procedure: Bind a small approved context-byte test limit and literal at-limit/one-over argv and env fixtures; include multibyte UTF8 and long module path forms. No large allocation or timing experiment is authorized by this data.

Distinguish unresolved guest state from an opaque host operation that cannot be preempted.

Authenticate exact entry/adapter/factory/evaluator load witnesses and isolate output/resource receipts per variant. No fabricated engine brand or guessed deep import is a control implementation.

holdouts.name: Primary reason presence, caller provenance and late cleanup are independent
holdouts.procedure: Use a finite four-variant raw-handler procedure with a controlled held host read: escaping execution rejection undefined then later cleanup error; caller object sentinel equal by identity to a local sentinel; synchronous provider create failure after registered child admission; normal execute followed by close rejection. Record first selection presence separately from its value, close admission, release/reap tracked work, and assert pending until closure. Bind actual outer Shell mapped-error observations separately; never expect every escaping raw handler failure to be an identical public Shell rejection.
holdouts.unresolved: Exact adapter API and each raw/Shell output/outcome binding remain future. An undefined execution rejection is not an assertion that AbortController.abort(undefined) exposes an undefined signal reason.
holdouts.countercontrol: Use nullish selection assignment, infer origin from reason equality, or skip registered cleanup when create throws.

holdouts.name: Closed stdout has a bound guest outcome without cancelling sibling writes
holdouts.procedure: Admit and hold the file write, close the enrolled stdout operation before its write, and then release the file. Observe whether the callback runs under the ratified guest-terminal policy, not merely final file bytes. Raw and actual Shell routes have separately frozen outcomes. No arbitrary sleep or global caller abort.
holdouts.unresolved: Guest closed-write return/throw/terminal semantics and whether done is emitted must be fixed before a runner can qualify this row; original N30 remains unchanged.
holdouts.countercontrol: Cancel the entire session to close stdout, ignore the held file, or accept either stderr result opportunistically.

holdouts.name: Exclusive create is a real adapter capability, not check then write
holdouts.procedure: Bind two independent invocations with literal final argv values A and B over one authorized controlled VFS. Hold both at the adapter's exclusive-create admission barrier; release A first then B. Expected A CREATED LF, B EEXIST LF and exact file A only if this option form and actual exclusive capability are qualified. An adapter without exclusive-create support must refuse before mutation, not simulate wx with lookup plus write.
holdouts.unresolved: Exact write-options schema, adapter capability/refusal and denial diagnostic binding required; no claim about unsynchronized w writes, transactions or remote services.
holdouts.countercontrol: Allow both calls to win via check-then-write, share invocation state or silently drop wx.
